input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for account, account, security config. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use account capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use discovery server capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
